newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil wins two Venezuelan contracts.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil wins two Venezuelan contracts.

text.p: Pennzoil Co said on Friday it was the successful bidder on two Venezuela development projects.

On June 3, a Pennzoil-led group bid $46 million to secure the contract to operate the B2X-68/79 field. The group includes Pennzoil, 60 percent owner; Nimir Petroleum Co Ltd, 20 percent; Ehcopek SA, 10 percent; and Cartera de Inversiones Venezolanas CA, 10 percent.
On June 4, a 50-50 venture between Pennzoil and PanCanadian Petroleum Ltd won the contract to operate the B2X-70/80 field with a bid of $1.3 million.
Pennzoil said the two fields, each of which cover 10,000 acres, are located near each other in eastern Lake Maracaibo.
Recoverable reserves on the two fields have the potential to be in the range of 100-200 million barrels, the company said.
B2X-68/79 currently has 39 active wells producing about 2,500 barrels per day. The minimum investment required during the first three years on B2X-68/79 is $12 million.
B2X-70/80 currently has 72 active wells producing about 5,800 barrels per day. The minimum investment required during the first three years on B2X-70/80 is $17 million.
